capabilities: Rename, merge, delete, and nest tags across all files
Bulk-convert tag case, separators, and YAML formats with preview
Show vault-wide tag statistics and detect malformed tags
Generate tag lists, hierarchy trees, and orphan reports
Undo destructive operations via a history log
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault before running destructive bulk operations, though an undo history is built in; support and bug reporting are via a Ko-fi link and GitHub issues.
intentEvidence: This plugin absorbed the functionalities from Tag Wrangler, by pjeby.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit tags vault-wide or to detect and fix inconsistencies like case duplicates, malformed YAML, or mixed tag formats.

relations.evidence: This plugin incorporates and extends the context menu and tag page functionality originally created by pjeby
Open Random Note -- Opens a random note tagged with the selected tag (requires the Smart Random Note plugin).

summary: Tag management dashboard that renames, merges, deletes, and bulk-standardizes tags and frontmatter properties across an entire vault.
